{{BPFK Section from tiki|BPFK Section: Indirect Referers|24}}
==Proposed Proposed Definitions ==

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: la'e (LAhE) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Indirect reference. It converts a sumti into another sumti. The converted sumti points to the referent of the referent of the unconverted sumti.

==== See Also ====
* {lu'e}
* {sinxa}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* the referent of

==== Usage Examples ====
;mi e do kakne lo nu pagre le cimdilnu i la'e di'u se nibli lo du'u mi'o mutce jarmau le cimdilnu:''Both you and I could walk through the fog. That was because we were much harder than the fog.''

;u'u mi na kakne lo nu xagmau cusku de'u sei la alis clite mutce spuda ki'u lo nu zu'u mi na jimpe la'e de'u:'''I'm afraid I can't put it more clearly,' Alice replied very politely, 'for I can't understand it myself to begin with [...]'''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: lu'e (LAhE) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Symbol. It converts a sumti into another sumti. The converted sumti points to a symbol for the referent of the unconverted sumti.

==== See Also ====
* {la'e}
* {sinxa}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* the symbol for

==== Usage Examples ====
fi lo ro sinxa pe la xisymivyxru lo sovda no'u lu'e lo ka ferti e lo ka cnino jmive cu traji lo ka dubju'o ce'u
<br>''Of all the symbols associated with Easter the egg, the symbol of fertility and new life, is the most identifiable.''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: tu'a (LAhE) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Abstraction. It converts a sumti into another sumti. The converted sumti points to an abstraction that has the referent of the unconverted sumti as an argument.

==== See Also ====
* {jai}
* {fai}

==== Proposed Keywords ====

==== Usage Examples ====
;le bimxra cu ralci tu'a le skari be le tsanybargu:''the wall-painting nuances in rainbow colours...''

;.iki'ubo zu'u so'iroiku mi terpa tu'a lei rigni jvinu be lei nanca poi tcena le purci:''for at times I feel appalling vistas of years stretching behind me'' 
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: lu'a (LAhE) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Individual. (Member.) 1. It converts a sumti into another sumti. The converted sumti points to the referents of the unconverted sumti, removing any indication of collectivization if there was any. 2. If the unconverted sumti is a set, the converted sumti refers to the members of the set.

==== See Also ====

==== Proposed Keywords ====

==== Usage Examples ====
;lei ci nanmu ku noi lu'a ke'a cu dasni lo mapku cu bevri le pipno:''The three men, who are individually wearing hats, carry the piano together.''

;lu'a A ku'a B du lu'a A e B:''A member of the intersection of A and B is a member of A and of B.''

;la alis ca le nu tolcliva cu te cpedu le nu jdice le cuntu kei ro lu'a le cimei:''The moment Alice appeared, she was appealed to by all three to settle the question'' 
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: lu'o (LAhE) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Mass. Collective. It converts a sumti into another sumti. It indicates that the referents of the unconverted sumti fit the slot they occupy non-distributively (collectively).

==== See Also ====

==== Proposed Keywords ====

==== Usage Examples ====
le ci nanmu ku noi lu'o ke'a bevri le pipno cu dasni lo mapku
<br>''The three men, who carry the piano together, are wearing hats.''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: lu'i (LAhE) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Set. It converts a sumti into another sumti. The converted sumti points to a set whose members are the referents of the unconverted sumti.

==== See Also ====

==== Proposed Keywords ====

==== Usage Examples ====
su'oci da cmima lu'i ma'a
<br>''At least three are members of the set of us.''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: vu'i (LAhE) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Sequence. It converts a sumti into another sumti. The converted sumti points to a sequence whose members are the referents of the unconverted sumti.

==== See Also ====

==== Proposed Keywords ====

==== Usage Examples ====
ro da poi cuxna cu benji lo cuxste po'u vu'i lo da se cuxna 
<br>''Each voter submits a ballot that gives his preferences among the candidates.''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: lu'u (LUhU) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Terminator for LAhE and for NAhE BO.

==== See Also ====

==== Proposed Keywords ====

==== Usage Examples ====
;.i xu tu'a mi lu'u fanza:''Am I bothering?  (Is the event involving me bothering?)''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: me'o (LI) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Numerical expression. It converts a mathematical or numerical expression (MEX) into a sumti. The sumti refers to the expression itself. It is usually a mathematical expression, but it may be any expression consisting of operands and operators.

==== See Also ====
* {li}
* {lo'o}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* mathematical expression
* numerical expression

==== Usage Examples ====
;le pimumei co lurba'otai pe bu'u le jubme cu se tarmi me'o .vav. bu: ''The croissant half on the table has the shape of the letter Vau.''

;i mi mutce lo ka nelci lo sance be me'o ky lo'o .e me'o ty: ''I like a lot the sound of the letter K and the letter T.''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: li (LI) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Number. It converts a mathematical or numerical expression (MEX) into a sumti. The sumti refers to the value of the numerical expression. It is usually a numerical value, but it may be any referent of a numerical expression, for example a date.

==== See Also ====
* {lo'o}
==== Proposed Keywords ====
* number
* number article
==== Usage Examples ====
li vo cu sumji li re li re
<br>''Four is the sum of two and two.''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: lo'o (LOhO) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Terminator for LI.

==== See Also ====
* {li}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* terminator

==== Usage Examples ====
;i mi mutce lo ka nelci lo sance be me'o ky lo'o .e me'o ty: ''I like a lot the sound of the letter K and the letter T.''
{{BPFK Section box close}}

{{BPFK Section box open}}
===Formal definitions ===

{| class="wikitable" 
|colspan=1| '''LAhE'''
|-
| la'e ''sumti'' || = lo se sinxa be ''sumti''
|-
| lu'e ''sumti'' || = lo sinxa be ''sumti''
|-
| tu'a ''sumti'' || = lo su'u ''sumti'' co'e 
|-
| lu'a ''sumti'' || = lo me ''sumti'' / lo cmima be ''sumti'' [noi selcmi] / lo se gunma be ''sumti'' [noi gunma]
|-
| lu'o ''sumti'' || = loi me ''sumti'' 
|-
| lu'i ''sumti'' || = lo'i me ''sumti''
|-
| vu'i ''sumti'' || = lo porselcmi be ''sumti'' enai lo na me ''sumti''
|}

{| class="wikitable" 
|colspan=1| '''LI''' 
|-
| me'o ''mex'' || lu ''mex'' li'u || lo mekso po'u lu ''mex'' li'u
|-
| li ''mex'' || la'e lu ''mex'' li'u || lo namcu po'u la'e lu ''mex'' li'u
|}

=== Notes ===
*These definitions are in agreement with CLL.
